public_rationale: Contemporary reporting supports the existence of an approximately $11 billion annual burn forecast. It does not establish that Anthropic misled investors. The allegation concerns the accuracy and completeness of a representation when made, so it cannot be settled simply by comparing fundraising totals with projected burn or waiting for a forecast miss.
limitations: The original report could not be read with read_page; the condition rests on an identified secondary account.
The forecast's cash-flow definition and complete investor presentation remain unavailable.
A forecast-outcome reading would concern unfinished years, but that reading would omit the central allegation of misleading investors.
